t: Collect 4 Rhino Horns from Bloodthirsty Isle and bring them to Hammerblow the Fierce.

Sigh. I'm in my eighties now and I'm getting old... If I were younger I'd head out to the prairies and beat the living daylights out of the Bloodthirsty and Roughneck Clan Orcs!
Yeah, I'm a warrior, but back in my day the shamans led all the clans and they took care of us, too. This new... development where warriors want to be their own masters - it's ridiculous!
And look at what those savages have done to our village. It's a disgrace! This kind of thing never happened back in my day. Sure, we had ourselves some wars, ruined some broads, polished some kissers - but why ruin the buildings! Where are we going to find trees in this prairie to rebuild the houses and the palisade?!
The answer is we can't! But old Hammerblow knows what to do. We'll just have to use whatever we can get our hands on. That's where the Bloodthirsty Clan comes in.
They've got a whole bunch of rhinos out there, and those rhinos have some pretty nice horns. They'll be perfect for building a new palisade! Their masters broke it, so the rhinos will have to foot the bill!
Gah, if only I was ten years younger I'd join you in your quest for horns. My oh my, together we'd score hundreds of 'em!

Just look at them! They're so beautiful, strong, and sharp. A bit on the small side, though. Hmm, I wonder what will happen if I plant them. Do you think they'll grow? I better ask the shamans, those guys know everything...
Gather 4 Pails of Rhino Milk from Bloodthirsty Isle and bring it to Gavelock the Fierce.

I'm old now and all I can do is look after our up-and-coming shamans. I hear that almost all they drink these days is tiger blood. That's a serious problem - sure tiger blood is good for you, but you need to have a balanced diet!
For example, in spite of their name the Bloodthirsty Clan is very health conscious. They domesticated rhinos and have a whole farm of them. They know that there's great strength in rhino milk! It's full of all the nutrients an Orcish needs.
Take these pails and fill all of them with milk. It'll probably be pretty dangerous - I'm sure the Bloodthirsty Orcs won't be too happy to see you, and the rhinos will be even less happy to be milked. But I just know once the Fierce clan gets enough of the milk, they'll be convinced to set up their own rhino farm!
Do you have the milk? Don't tell me our boys are stuck with nothing but blood to slurp down?
Finally! I've been waiting forever for this stuff. There's nothing better than fresh rhino milk! Here, take this potion for all your help - I'm sure you'll make good use of it!
Kill 4 Wild Rhinoceros Bulls and return to Wilna the Nomadic.

Shh! Don't scare off the game! I'm Wilna from the Nomadic Clan, and I couldn't give a damn about these stupid clan wars. Life is about exploring, hunting, and freedom!
It's definitely not about bashing each other's skulls in and abiding by suffocating traditions. My clan knows this well. Sigh, if only the other Orcs were like that.
Today I decided to hunt wild rhinos. They are noble creatures, worthy of my time. They're much more worthy prey than some of these Orcs. You can join me if you like, but I'm not letting you take any kills, so don't get any ideas! You'll have to find your own prey and take them down by yourself.
I highly suggest you join me, though, 'cause hunting is just so much fun! It's possibly the best thing there is in life. Well, what do you say?
So, you having fun? Me, I love this stuff! Sitting in ambush, stalking your prey, and then bang! Ain't nothing better!
You're my kind of person! I love those who love life and take what they want from it. C'mere, let me give you a little kiss! C'mon now, quit blushing!
Find Ortag the Fierce on the Righteous Isle and persuade him to join the Fierce Clan's Goblinball team.

Whoa, hold on a second. There's still one problem. There should be six players on a team, right? Right. But all we've got are two veterans and three trainees. That means we're still short a player.
I have an Orc in mind that would make a damn fine goalie. Problem is, he ditched the clan a while ago to be a hunter. These kinds of things happen sometimes - there's no unity among us anymore! Maybe Lek can change that, but I'm not gonna hold my breath.
In any case, it would be great if you could head on over to Righteous Isle and find him. His name is Orn, and you've got to convince him to come back! Tell him the whole clan needs him right now!

I don't want to hear about my clan! I'm a lone wolf - get that through your head! There's no way I'm going back. Those shamans have too many rules. I can't breathe when I'm there! Out here I answer to no one and I don't have a care in the world. Plus the hunting season's about to start...
Well hold on, hold on. I didn't say "no" yet! Give me time to think about it I guess.
Sacrifice 4 animals on Righteous Isle to the spirit of Rodogor. Place sacrificial marks over their bodies. Return to Tord the Fierce afterwards.

Picking a chieftain without a fight?
He is right - in our struggle for power we always lose our best fighters. And we really need them right now with the clan wars that are going on!
 Our main adversary in the Wild Isles is the Righteous Clan. Even though they didn't attack our settlement! But I won't be surprised if it turns out that they incited the fighters. They are clever!
They know how to draw their strength from the ancestors. They don't care about Tensess's sacrifice or Nezeb's greatness. If we can use the magic of Light, why not do it our own way? We should follow their example!
Go to Righteous Isle and offer 4 eagles or hyenas as a sacrifice to Rodogor, a great shaman of the past. Then I will forgo the battle for power. I'll give you sacrificial marks - place them over their carcasses.
With the spirits watching over us, we're sure to succeed! The shamans must emerge victorious, no matter the cost!

Rodogor should be pleased! Hopefully he'll remember our clan and send us the victories we deserve. He should be capable of that, even from the afterlife. After all, Rodogor was a great shaman. It was him who struck the alliance with Xadaganians. We Orcs owe him a great deal!
I've lost the symbol. Can you please give me another one?
h: I've lost the symbol. Can you please give me another one?

t: Kill Klakan, show his head to Clad the Righteous, and report back to Baske the Righteous.

I'm completely confident that we're gonna win the Goblinball Tournament. But I suppose we do have a little problem right now.
You see, an Orc by the name of Clad is one of our best players, but recently he's stopped coming to training sessions. He's met some pretty lass and now all he thinks about is her. The last thing I heard he ran off near the pyre and began slaughtering a bunch of hyenas. He said he was going to bring his girl the head of the pack leader for a birthday present. What foolishness! This is the worst time possible to be slacking on his training and he knows it! I think I know how he can be stopped, though.
Go find that hyena and kill him for yourself. Then show his head to Clad, and once he realizes that he failed his little mission I'm sure he'll come back to us. There's no way he's gonna face his girl's anger when she finds out she's not gonna get what she wants.
Well, have you brought an end to Clad's little fantasies? He's our key player and we need him back!

Haha, this is excellent! Now Clad will get his head out of the clouds and concentrate on what's important in life!
Here's a reward for all your help.
Kill 4 Dusty Hyenas and return to Stirp the Nomadic.

Great, help has arrived just when I need it! I'm sure you feel like making a few coins, right? You see, the members of the Righteous Clan have put out an order for all of the hyenas to be exterminated. They want the beasts gone for good.
That's why I even came over here, you see. My clan isn't known for setting down roots, so we typically go our own way, living off the land and taking odd jobs when we can.
The problem is that there's a deadline and I can't do it alone. If you help me out, I'll be willing to give you some of the reward and hand over this old equipment that I don't need any more. So, what do you say?
All I'm asking is that you don't slack. Back up your words with actions or you won't be getting any of this reward. Now get on out there - those hyenas are waiting for you!
Good deal. Now the order will be completed in time. Here's the coin and equipment I promised. Thanks a bunch buddy!
Collect a Rhino Hide, 2 Eagle Feathers, and a Goblin Amulet for Ortag the Fierce on Righteous Isle.

Fine, I'll play goalie for the Fierce Clan.
But I expect to be well compensated for my services. I've made a list of everything I want. Here, take a look:
1. One rhino hide for new clothes.
2. Two eagle feathers for my arrows.
3. One goblin amulet to bring me good luck.
The rhinos graze over on the Bloodthirsty Isle, there are tons of eagles here on the Righteous Isle, and there are plenty of goblins over on the Roughneck Isle.
Excessive demands? What did you expect? I'm not just some Orc, I'm the best damn goalie around! And the cost for my services is more than justified, you got that?!
Remember I want the goods up front. I know the shamans and their tricks. I'm no fool!
Now we're talking! Only birds sing for you free of charge. Orn's gotta look out for number one. Us loner types have to take advantage of these limited opportunities.
Plant the Imbued Shamanic Totem by the pyre on Righteous Isle and return to Lek the Roughneck.

I'm sure your travels will eventually lead you to Righteous Isle. I would really appreciate it if you could do me a favor, but it's a bit of a delicate mission. You see, we don't want to start a war with another clan of Orcs again.
Righteous Isle is the home of the Righteous Clan, and many of their numbers have become paladins. They believe that their holy power is superior to ours - that it's better than the power given to us by nature and our ancestors. It's ridiculous!
They made a large pyre on the allod that uses holy magic to burn what they deem to be evil forces. They say that the energy it gives off invigorates them. Personally, I don't believe in any of this new-age stuff, but I have to make sure. Take this shamanic totem to Righteous Isle. When you place it next to the pyre it should react to the holy energy and you'll be able to tell whose magic is stronger.
But make sure the Righteous Clan doesn't figure out what you're doing - I'm sure they'd get offended and issue our clan an outright challenge to prove their power. The last thing we need is more bloodshed!
Well, what happened with the totem? Don't tell me that the Righteous Clan didn't let you near the pyre?

Just as I thought, our power is stronger! This information will give our team great confidence in the upcoming Goblinball Tournament. But don't tell anyone about what you did, alright? Trust me, it's in everyone's best interest!
Kill Badonet the Roughneck and return to Talip the Fierce.

You want me to surrender the position of chief to some shaman? Are you out of your mind?! Just look at what those losers have done to our clan. We barely survived, we're so weak! And now Lek wants me to just hand over my weapon?!
Argh, if only this clan had more warriors. We wouldn't let anyone push us around then. I'll take a hardy fighter over a shaman any day of the week. What I wouldn't give to lead a clan like that...
Take the Roughneck Clan, for instance - good fighters, all of them, not like our wimps! Too bad they already got themselves a chieftain...
Say, should the chieftain of the Roughneck Clan suddenly croak, I'd gladly ditch our clan to try and take his place. If you arrange for that to happen, I might just give up my bid for the chief of this clan.
How's the chief of the Roughneck Clan doing? Alive and kicking? Meh, looks like I'll have no choice but to claim leadership of the Fierce Clan. Can you tell how excited I am? Heh.

That's excellent news! Now to pack my bags and get over there before another sap rises to power. Here, take my battleaxe as a symbol of my submission. I'll just pick up a better one before I get there. See ya!
I've lost the symbol. Can you please give me another one?
h: I've lost the symbol. Can you please give me another one?

t: Bring 4 Bloody Goblin Heads to Geg the Roughneck.

Argh!
Ever since the Orcs joined the Empire, everything's been going straight to hell! It's one thing to have Orcs fighting Orcs, but now the fighters from the Roughneck Clan brought goblins into this, setting their filthy pets on their own kind! A disgrace, that's what this is!
Back on Izune this would earn an Orc a slow and shameful death. Our wars here are our business, others can't be involved. Especially not goblins! Then they'll start thinking that killing Orcs is okay. Drastic measures must be taken!
You're still here? Off with you to Roughneck Isle! Now! Kill as many of those filthy goblins as possible and bring me their heads as proof. Let this be a lesson to them. Let them know that their crimes will not go unpunished!
Let this be a lesson for both the goblins and the Orcs who dare to violate age-old traditions!
Splendid! It's good to have you around, you know? Together we're a force to be reckoned with! Here, take this weapon, it'll come in handy.
Recover the Ancient Shamanic Amulet from a goblin on Roughneck Isle and bring it to Gavelock the Fierce.

I always knew that an alliance with the goblins was ill-fated! Alas, the shamans are no longer an authority among the Orcs - the warriors want to live off their instincts, never listening to reason. What a terrible idea!
During the attack I spied several of the Roughneck Clan's goblins slip off the battlefield and start rummaging through our camp, swiping everything they could lay their paws on. Filthy marauders!
Turns out an old amulet of mine is now gone. The offense is two-fold - not only did they steal from me, but those brainless beasts won't even be able to put the amulet to good use. They can't know the true power it holds.
Please make for Bloodthirsty Isle and recover the stolen amulet. One of the goblins has to have it. It's up to you to find the right one.
If this amulet isn't found, I might just have to go on a rampage. I can't be expected to be accountable for my actions!
That's it! That's my precious amulet. If it weren't for you I don't know when or if I'd ever see it again. Thanks for your help.
Burn down 3 buildings in the Roughneck Clan's village and return to Hammerblow the Fierce.

I helped build our village with my bare hands, you know! So much of my soul was put into these buildings, so much time and effort... And then those barbarians from the Roughneck Clan razed it all to the ground. Everything gone in less than a hour.
But they should have known that Orcs follow the rule of an eye for an eye. If they wanted their village to stand, they shouldn't have touched ours!
This offense will not go unpunished! But I'm old, too old to exact the proper revenge. Please, can you take this torch and burn down the buildings in their camp? Remember to hit their tavern, their smithy, and their chieftain's home! Then I'll be able to move on and rebuild.
Don't tell me you weren't able to set the enemy's houses on fire? Do I have to find another helper?
Have you got good news for this old man? The flames were huge, eh? Serves them right, those monsters! They got what was coming to them. Now let them wallow in their own ashes!
Collect 4 Roughneck Totems and bring them to Awl the Fierce.

We've already rid ourselves of the Bloodthirsty Clan. Now our focus is going to be the Roughneck Clan!
Now this plan is going to be a bit more complicated. Killing and humiliating them won't help - they'll just replace the players and keep plugging away. That means we need to use alternative methods.
Here's my idea. Everyone knows that the members of the Roughneck Clan are extremely superstitious. They don't take the field unless they have enchanted totems. I know, it's very hypocritical isn't it - they think shamans are weak yet they require their trinkets to fight.
Anyway, if you figure out a way to swipe the talismans then the Roughneck Clan will surrender for sure.
Now listen up - I head they keep their totems in little boxes under close guard in their camp. Take care of the guards any way you have to and bring me those totems!
Where are the totems? This may be our only chance to stop the Roughneck Clan. The bastards are fertile, I tell you! They replace fallen players faster than you can waste them!

The Roughneck players won't enter the field without their trinkets, not even on pain of death! That means we've only got one opponent left - the punishers of the Righteous Clan. When we crush them, our victory will force all of the Orcs to give our clan the proper respect!
Replace the goblin head at the Goblinball stadium and talk to the Goblinball manager.

Well, now that I'm the chief of the Fierce Clan I need to help my people prepare for the Goblinball Tournament.
Everything's almost ready but there's just one more thing that needs doing. You're going to replace the goblin head that we use as a ball with the one I'm going to give you. It should be on a stake just outside the stadium on Savage Isle.
I know, this is a bit underhanded, but our clan has to win! We've lost a lot of respect lately because our clan is mostly shamans, and the warriors think they should rule our race now. If we wait any longer to claim a victory, the shamans may lose whatever remaining authority we have left! Then more and more Orcs will become savage cutthroats. And that will spell the end of Orcish freedom and independence The rest of the Empire will lose trust in us and they'll be constantly breathing down our necks. That's what's really at stake here - the fate of the Orcs.
We must be victorious, whatever it takes!
After you swap the head, tell the Goblinball manager that our team is ready to take the field. Once we win, I'll tell you what happened to Skulnar.
Please don't tell me that the Fierce Clan team won't be playing! We've just had two teams withdraw from the Tournament. If the Fierce Clan doesn't show up, there won't be a tournament at all!

So they will play! Finally some good news.
Well, it looks like there will only be one match in this tournament. But that just makes it all the more suspenseful I suppose.
Bring Goggleye's Booze to Victor Udovin.

There's a reason this allod is called "Savage" - it's teeming with all kinds of terrible fauna! Trolls, minotaurs, ogres, you name it.
If you only knew what we went through to build a stadium here. But we didn't have a choice! If we were to choose an allod inhabited by one of the Orcish clans - just imagine how angry the others would get. I get a headache just thinking about it.
Speaking of headaches, listen to this - they sent us a group of Orcish cheerleaders to warm up the crowd. The girls are just super! But they're city girls and they get kind of jittery around these wild Orcs.
Can you help me out with a plan to calm them down? There's a giant cyclops that lives nearby. He's a well known boar farmer named Goggleye, but he brews this fantastic beer too. If you could steal some for our girls I know they'd loosen up and calm down.
Don't bother asking him for it because I know he's not going to share. You'll have to waste him. The only other way would be to kill a bunch of his boars. He might run out to check on them, and when that happens you could sneak inside and grab it. It's your choice, just get me the booze!
Well, do you have it or not? The Tournament is about to start and the girls will be out in the arena any minute now!

Ah, there it is! I won't even guess what ingredients Goggleye uses to make it. I just know that one swig of this concoction and our girls will dance so hard the Orcs' brains will melt and leak out of their skulls!
Bring 4 pieces of Juicy Boar Meat to Miroslav Grubin.

Ho-ho-hey, ho-ho-hey, kiss me darling, whaddaya say! Calm down, I'm just memorizing some poetry. There are parties scheduled after the Tournament, and I've been appointed host.
But I'm a little lost, to be honest. I've never worked with wild Orcs, and I have a strong suspicion that my regular jokes won't go over too well. And I don't even want to think about party games. Can you even picture wild Orcs clenching a stick with their knees and passing it around? I know I sure can't.
So I'm thinking of cutting the entertainment program and just leaving the food. And then the guests will take care of themselves, I've been told. There's just one problem - we didn't bring that much meat.
I guess the suppliers underestimated the Orcish appetite. Do you think you could you lend me a hand? I've seen some boars grazing out in the prairie. Their meat would be perfect for the party.
How goes the hunt? Getting that meat will make my job a lot easier.

Excellent! That's a load off my mind. As they say, when the Orcs stay happy, Xadaganians stay in one piece. Haha! What, not funny? Hmm, maybe you're right - the joke is a bit dubious. A bit too political, too. Listen, don't pass it around, alright?
Collect 4 Astral Power Supplies stolen by Minotaurs and bring them to Semer Khuit.

Want to know if the Arisen can feel hatred? Well, I'll tell you - you betcha! Some hate Tep, some hate their late mother-in-law, but me? I hate those minotaurs!
Tell me, how did you get here? That's right - you took a ship? Why, you might ask? Because the damn portal is still out of order! It should have been fixed days ago in preparation for the Tournament. Do you know how many people won't bother to come to this thing unless we have a portal running? It'll be a huge flop!
It would have been done if those minotaurs hadn't attacked the convoy that was delivering the portal's power supplies. Just imagine - our brave soldiers walking along peacefully, diligently dragging those heavy things along, when suddenly a horde of minotaurs ambushes them and wreaks havoc. How do you like that visual!
Tell me, what the heck do minotaurs need batteries for anyway?! They don't have a clue what to do with them! Damn scavengers is what they are, swiping anything they can get their hooves on.
Look at me, cursing like an Orc. I need to finish my job, wait out those games, and get off this allod before I pick up any more of their habits. Can you please get the batteries back for me?!
I'm sure the minotaurs have already realized they won't be able to use the things. They've probably left them scattered around the whole allod by now. Good luck finding them!
Wow, those are really the power supplies! Now I'll finally be able to start up the portal! Here, take this weapon as a reward. Please use it to smash any minotaurs you come across in the future.
Kill Horny the Barbaric and return to Braga the Unyielding.

Whatcha staring at? Never seen a wounded Orc before? Yes, I was part of the convoy that had to deliver those Astral power supplies! Yes, I fought Horny! And yes, I lost the battle. Grr, barbaric scum!
Phew, I feel better now. I needed to vent. Look, I'm a civilized Orc, not like these savages. I fought a fight and I lost. And to me that's no reason to jump into the Astral, though that's what the clan laws stipulate.
It's just that... I feel like crap, you know? I want revenge! More than anything in the world, I want revenge! Except with this wound here I'm not much of an avenger.
Hey, I've got an idea! Why don't you avenge me? It makes perfect sense! Once Horny dies I'll be at peace. And if I'm not the one who kills him, that'll put me above all these ancient Orcish traditions. Everybody wins! Well, except for Horny, haha!
Maybe I should just go after Horny myself... No, I won't succumb to blind revenge! Besides, what if he beats me up again?
You killed him?! Hurray! Eh, somehow I don't feel too good about this though. I probably should have done it myself. Maybe us city Orcs are becoming too soft after all...
Kill 4 Minotaur Marauders. Report to Gerasim Nadzorin on the Savage Isle.

Sometimes I wonder what the heck I'm doing here on the Wild Isles!
Working here's way too dangerous. When the Orcs start brawling I have to break them up and I'm the first one who suffers.
And I won't even mention the minotaurs, they're a real bundle of joy... Just the other day they pillaged some convoy and stole the power supplies for the portal for no reason. Did you know they're considered to be intelligent creatures? Could've fooled me!
Well, if they are intelligent, that doesn't make things any easier for us. On the contrary. If those horned bastards decide to crash the Tournament, I shudder to think of the consequences!
Listen, you can help everyone by killing four of their kind.
How can I be expected to keep order when at any moment I could get minotaur horns rammed into my backside?!
The minotaurs finally got what was coming to them! Things will be a bit more peaceful now. Thank you for helping your country.
Demand an explanation from the Crazy Skewer!

Everyone, I need silence! I've got something to tell you, so shut up! That's better...
I regret to inform you that the Goblinball Tournament will not be taking place. It has come to our attention that the Fierce Clan has sent an agent to sabotage their competitors before the game.
It was them who disgraced the Bloodthirsty Clan's team! And it was them who stole the Roughneck Clan's talismans! And they even tried to tamper with the Righteous Clan's holy pyre!
Now I know what you're thinking - "so what"? You might even think "well done"! But now I must tell you that they also swapped the official goblinball with a replacement! It has been enchanted so that any member from the Righteous Clan that touches it will lose his holy powers.
And that, my friends, is foul play! It's one thing to sabotage your enemies, and another to sabotage official Tournament equipment! Beside me stands their agent, the one responsible for all the things I mentioned! Now tell me, Orcs, what is your verdict?

Shh, settle down. Trust me, I'm just as sorry as you are about all this. Remember Crazystorm the Merciless? Well, he's my fellow clan member and he's said some good things about you. And I don't think he'll be pleased if a horde of furious Orcs tear you to pieces.
Unfortunately, I couldn't let that sabotage slide. The Fierce Clan is disgraced and that was my real goal, not getting you killed. Let me think of some way to get you out alive.
What do you think about the Ancestral Court? It's a kind of duel where you'll fight representatives from each of the three clans. It's an ancient Orcish tradition and you're within your rights to demand it. Say yes, and quickly - there's no other way! Say yes or start running!
Bring Victor Udovin's message to Skewer the Merciless.

Everyone's already in their seats! The fans are already plastered - I mean animated! The teams are warmed up and ready to go. The cheerleaders are looking lovely. And that means it's time to finally start the First Annual Goblinball Tournament!
Head to the arena and find Skewer the Merciless. He's the referee and you need to tell him that "the time has come!" Repeat those exact words and he'll know what to do.

You're finally here. I was getting pretty tired of waiting. So "the time has come," huh? Hm.
I know you and Lek put a lot of work into ensuring your victory. It was a good effort. A good effort indeed... And now you'll understand why I say that.
Defeat Murd the Bloodthirsty and report to Skewer the Merciless.

Listen up! The Tournament may have been canceled, but we've been given an opportunity to honor the memory of our ancestors! The agent of the Fierce Clan has opted to undergo the Ancestral Court!
They will face three duelists. Each of the clans will present their strongest and mightiest warrior. If their fighter loses, then the Fierce Clan agent will have merited the blessing of our great ancestors. Then the losing clan must drop their charges and vow to never threaten them again. So says the law, so says tradition!
Here comes the first duelist - Murd! He's a scout that hails from the Bloodthirsty Clan and looks to defend that clan's honor! May his name know eternal glory! Let the fight begin!
Fight, damn you! Don't give up or they'll tear you to pieces!
Murd is down! That means the first duel is over! The ancestors favor the Fierce Clan's representative!
Defeat Purshin the Righteous and report to Skewer the Merciless.

The last but not least duelist hails from the Righteous Clan!
He is one you Orcs should know well! When the preachers from the Trinity Church came to Wild Isles, he was the one that made sure you all wouldn't tear them to pieces. For three days he protected the priests, and the road to their camp was paved with the corpses of countless Orcs. It is the one, the only, Purshin!
I hope you can handle the holy magic of the Trinity Church!

The third and final duelist has fallen! The Ancestral Court is over and the ancestors have spoken! The representative of the Fierce Clan shall live!
But remember this day, Orcs. This day is when the shamans showed their true colors! Let their kind fall, and let the warrior clans thrive!
Defeat Brod the Roughneck and report to Skewer the Merciless.

The duelist from the Bloodthirsty Clan has fallen, and now the second fighter is entering the arena! It is Brod - the son of Pigsticker the Roughneck and the personal guard to the chief of the Roughneck Clan! He's driven by revenge for his slaughtered clan members, which means that the ancestors are on his side!
Let's see how the agent of the Fierce Clan handles this mighty warrior. Will they be victorious? The odds look pretty slim, but who knows what will happen? Now let the fight begin!
Brod is blind with anger. It should be easy to take advantage of his recklessness!
Brod is down! Could it be that the agent of the Fierce Clan brings more to the table than we expected? It looks like the final match is going to be an interesting one!
Return to Lek the Fierce and report on all that happened.

Bah, I've nearly lost my voice from all that shouting! Man, that was a kickass event! All that blood and carnage warms the heart! The shamans are disgraced and you're still in one piece! Everybody's happy!
You know, I really didn't expect you to make it. Well done! I can see now why Crazystorm values you as he does.
Of course, if Purshin defeated you as we originally planned, it would've been even better - a full-fledged victory! But who knew that you were the Fierce Clan's agent? I sure didn't!
But you've got to admit, those shamans are real scumbags for dragging you into this. Our plan was flawless, we even forgot all about the meddling of the City Council. Oh, you didn't know? Yep, the Council's involved in all this as well.
Go on now, head back to Lek and let him know about all that took place here. He'll pass that on to Wrokag, and I can just imagine what his reaction will be!
I trust that you bring good news. I'd hate to think that all our preparations were for naught.
Ask Yaver Maiherpri about Skulnar the Fierce.

What, we're disgraced? This is terrible!
Now everyone knows about what we did! I can't believe this happened! I didn't even make that stupid goblin head that you planted. It was given to me by the Council's detective! And I remember his words verbatim - "I realize the importance of the Fierce Clan's victory! We Arisen scientists can help the shamans earn the respect they deserve." That lying weasel!
The City Council must have been in cahoots with the warriors from the beginning. All along they planned to disgrace the shamans, to make us lose respect amongst our own kind! And I helped them achieve their goal! The only silver lining is that the detective promised to give you some information. He knows about the final descendant of the Legendary Orc. That's right, at least he can be useful for something! Even Horz let Skulnar slip away, but I was finally able to track him down!
Listen, sorry for not telling you everything that was going on. You think it's easy being the chief? And I thought for sure we were gonna win... Well, go talk to the detective and give me some time to think.

Well, I see no reason to hide the truth from you. Yes, we were trying to decrease the shamans' influence among the Orcs. Yasker and the City Council consider this to be a matter of very high priority.
We need the Orcs to become part of the Empire, and right now the shamans are dreaming of independence, putting ideas into the locals' heads. And that is why we must cut the ground from under their feet.
As far as the descendant of the Legendary Orc goes, that stuff is nothing but legend, and soon we shall prove it!
Bring Yaver Maiherpri's message to Wrokag the Northwind.

Why are the shamans even trying to separate from the Empire? The Orcs alone will never be able to keep their allods from being devoured by the Astral, so any hope for independence is simply out of the question!
Sure, there are a few Orcs that exhibited a small potential for higher magic, but this can easily be attributed to Astral mutations. The last alleged descendant of the Legendary Orc is currently held in one of our laboratories. He's undergoing a battery of tests that will undoubtedly prove us right once and for all.
Feel free to tell this to Wrokag the Northwind what I said. He cannot stop us, and the sooner he gives up his foolish and empty ambitions, the better it will be for everyone.

Damn them all to hell! I knew that those City Council scumbags would try to ruin our plans! They don't want us to have our independence and will do whatever they can to prevent it!
And now I'm super angry! They're obviously skilled at lies and intrigue, and I don't believe a word they say. If Skulnar really was powerless, they wouldn't have locked him up in their lab! We need to get to the bottom of this!
Bring 5 Rare Saddles to Lek the Fierce.

I know you've been helping the clan out a lot lately, cracking skulls and taking out wild creatures just so we can get back on our feet. But I have another task you could do that we would greatly appreciate.
This time, all I'm asking is that you bring us some equipment. That sounds simple enough, right? The thing we need the most are some new leather saddles to replace our old and damaged ones.
If you're a leatherworker this job should be pretty easy. And if not, then maybe you can go buy some. I hear that there are tons of people in the capital, just waiting to trade their goods. If you can get them for us, we'd be incredibly grateful.
The Fierce Clan appreciates all the support we can get! Especially if it's backed up by deeds.
These are excellent! Just excellent! Now we're well prepared for a new military campaign thanks to friends like you!
How can anyone lose such thing as a goblin head? Alright, here's another.
Find Horz the Fierce on Fierce Isle.

So it seems we've been betrayed by Strina. Damnit! The descendants of the Legendary Orc could only be counted on one hand to begin with. One hand! Now Voxar is dead and Strina ran away. That means that there is only one heir left. His name is Skulnar the Fierce, and he appears to be the cousin of our first two heirs.
All we know about him is that he aspires to be a great Goblinball player, which is why he headed to the Wild Isles. We'll need you to follow him as soon as possible. First you should go visit Fierce Isle, named after the clan that owns it. The clan is run by us shamans, which means they should be very eager to assist you in your mission. The Orc in charge is named Horz. He's an old buddy of mine and if anyone can help you, it's him.
The boat that lands at the dock between the Nezebgrad Port and Cape Stronghold should take you straight to where you need to go. And remember how important this mission is - there is only one descendant of the Legendary Orc left, and his protection is vital!
Horz? Aye, there he is on the funeral pyre! He's dead. He was a great fighter, but they outnumbered him ten to one! Now I'm the leader of this clan. Well, not officially. Not yet, anyway...
Meet with Baske the Righteous on Righteous Isle.

You should visit the Wild Isles soon. It's a small archipelago where many of the Orcs have been living for generations. The local clans are wholly isolated from civilization, and the government has been putting in a lot of work into making them less barbaric.
One example of such efforts is the construction of a stadium in the middle of Savage Isle. We're hoping those Orcs will stop fighting each other and start playing more Goblinball instead. In fact, the Wild Isles will soon host the first annual Goblinball Tournament, and we need to make sure it goes off without a hitch.
Speak with the team trainer of the Righteous Clan when you get there. He should be able to tell you more about what's going on. By the way, their team is also under my patronage, and I would love it if they emerged victorious at the Tournament. Do I make myself clear?
You can take a ship from the Nezebgrad Port straight to Wild Isles. The portal there is still under construction, so sailing is your only option at the moment. You should land at Fierce Isle, and from there you should make your way to Righteous Isle to the east.

Crazystorm sent you? Thanks for the help, but we hardly need it now. Victory's pretty much in the bag! You need to understand that the ancestors are on our side, and that's the only thing that matters! But don't worry, I'm sure we'll find something to keep you busy.
Participate in killing 4 Dusty Ogres and 10 Muddy Trolls and report to Gerasim Nadzorin.

I've been watching you since you've landed on Savage Isle, and I'm impressed with how you handle yourself soldier. But do you have the guts to try your hand at a real mission? To battle a truly perilous foe?
I'm talking about the trolls and the ogres around here. Trust me, I'd do nothing but pray to Tensess all day if that would ensure those beasts don't attack us! They could raze our whole stadium to the ground and not even break a sweat!
I figure it's best not to wait for them to strike first. That's why I've been looking for a soldier to launch a preemptive strike of our own. Do you think you could take out as many as possible, give them a taste of what would happen if they came any closer?
Man, do I have rotten luck or what! Everywhere you look it's nothing but danger! Those trolls and ogres are the worst of the lot.
Thank you very much! Remember that when the Tournament starts and everyone's having a good time, they'll have you to thank for their safety!
Participate in killing Goggleye and return to Gerasim Nadzorin on Savage Isle.

Do you want to know what my main headache is? No, it's not the minotaur. And no, it's not the ogres or the trolls. Those were good guesses though. I'll tell you - it's that cyclops!
Which cyclops? That huge one named Goggleye that lives just to the east of the Goblinball Arena. He's a bit of a bully and extremely unstable. Last time he was stung by a bee, he went on a rampage and took out three Orcs that happened to be nearby. Imagine if he was stung by a wasp or something! He could destroy the whole arena!
Now I won't lie - I would be completely useless if I went over to his lair. Even for a seasoned soldier like you, I would recommend that you get help. But if you do manage to get a good group and bring Goggleye down, I promise you'll get a pretty nice reward.
I shudder to think what would happen if he accidentally got poked in the eye. He might destroy the whole allod!
This is fantastic! After all your work, I suppose this allod isn't very savage after all, eh? Haha! Now here's your reward.
Use the ancient June ruins to get to Savage Isle and then report back to Hammerblow the Fierce.

Not far from here, there are some ancient June ruins that you can use to get to Savage Isle. They're amazing, really! Before we got these nifty Adventurer's Stones from the government, you won't believe how we got from allod to allod.
Bridges! Yes, that's right, bridges. Flimsy old things of rope and wood that were always being cut apart by enemy clans. Pah! Not to mention what would happen if you happened to be ON one when that happened.
Those poor souls... Anyway, I'd advise you to go on over to those ruins and use them to head to Savage Isle. It'll be a great experience, learning how to use the things and seeing the biggest allod in the Wild Isles.
You should come back to me after you've taken the trip and tell me what you think!
It's not scary at all, I assure you. Actually, it's kind of fun gazing into the Astral as you float along...
So, that was pretty educational, eh? It's information that should come in very handy during your stay here in the Orcish allods!
Find the 3 Stones of the Wild Isles and report back to anthropologist Luka the Fierce.

You know, to be able to call yourself a true scholar, you must be very aware of your's surroundings.
As a test, I have placed three stones imbued with magic around the Wild Isles. Explore these great allods, find the stones and report back to me.
Only after you have done this will I agree to take you under my wing. You can find these stones on Roughneck Isle, Bloodthirsty Isle, and Savage Isle. Good luck, traveler.
What are you waiting for? You'll never learn more if you can't follow instructions.
Great! You're on your way to becoming a great anthropologist yourself!
Kill 50 Bloodthirsty Clan Orcs and report back to anthropologist Luka the Fierce.

The Wild Isles is my home, so it pains me to say that it's far from perfect. But it's the truth.
If it weren't for that damned Bloodthirsty Clan, we'd be great! But they decided to cause all sorts of trouble and mess everything up.
I need you to get out there and show them the errors of their ways! They need to join the other clans and behave themselves!
You've taught them a lesson, right?

Good.
They need to learn that their actions have consequences!
Collect 4 Wild Isles Trophies from the most dangerous creatures and return to Anthropologist Luka the Fierce.

Listen, I know you're a seasoned traveler and all, but these are the Wild Isles!
You let your guard down for one second and that's it! It's all over! I want you to get used to the dangers of a place like this, so I need you to venture out and kill four of Wild Isle's most dangerous creatures!
But you need to give me proof – a trophy from the likes of Dusthoof, a ferocious wild tiger, Goldbeak, Grimetooth, or Earthstomper will do just fine.
Well? Have those creatures been defeated?

Excellent!
I knew you could do it. And by defeating these beasts, you now know more about the local fauna.
Collect 5 Goat's Rue Roots for anthropologist Luka the Fierce.

Tell me, have you heard of goat's rue?
What?! It's made from a special root that you can only find here on the Wild Isles. It's the reason why the orc here are so... Numerous. Heh. You get it? It's a special rue that the ocrish men take! Ha ha!
Anyway, you can find it all over the Isles, so please bring me whatever you find! Let's say, five roots will be enough.
There's so few of my clan left. We desperately need that rue!
Great! We'll be sure to put this to good use. If you know what I mean...
Complete all of the Anthropologist's tasks and report back to Luka the Fierce.

If you can successfully complete all my tasks, you'll be generously rewarded.
And I'm not talking about some rinky-dink potion! You'll have the knowledge that you've gained from this adventure as well as some prime equipment that's bound to help you on your future journeys!
So, find the stones, defeat the beasts, and gather some valuable resources here in the Wild Isles!
Have you completed all of my tasks?

Great.
You know, I didn't think you'd be able to do it. Thank you for proving me wrong! Go ahead and take your reward!

Hmm... This thing clearly looks a little out of place. Maybe you should study it more carefully.
The Orcs are known to be a paranoid race, probably due to all the fighting that goes on between them. This is probably somebody's secret stash! Finders keepers - they should find a better hiding place next time!
This appears to be the cache of the Roughneck Clan's chief. And now his treasures will go to a brave explorer!
Find the hidden treasure in the Orcish villages and report your success to Gavelock the Fierce.

Those blasted Orcs pillaged our camp when they attacked. They took all of the best stuff they could carry and are now using it for themselves! This kind of thing can't be tolerated!
Hey, when you're out there dealing out the pain they deserve, keep an eye open for any treasure. They should have mountains of it after what they recently stole. It doesn't belong in their hands, and they won't be able to use it anyway once we slaughter them! Hehe.
No, I'm not asking you to bring it back. It's likely that it belonged to an Orc that's dead now anyway. It's just a tip. I'm sure you'd enjoy a little extra loot for all the work you're doing.
Well, did you find anything good out there?
Excellent! Now their treasure can be used against them to make sure they never pillage us again!
Collect 4 Shards of Light and bring them to Nomarkh Netjerkare.

So, there's a certain black stone that's responsible for the appearance of strange shadowy creatures. It's the same type of stone that was discovered in Tep's sarcophagus. It's also known that the stone inhibits resurrection. As to the cause of this, that part remains unclear. At which point the matter was brought to my doorstep.
What in Tep's name took you so long! Here we are with essentially the same problem - our men are not resurrecting, and their souls are cursed, unable to find their bodies! Now they wander the halls, attacking all who come near!
In the past these sorts of things would appear only when they had no body to return to, but this is a very different phenomenon. The bodies are there, but the souls simply cannot find them!
Listen, we need to study those lost souls. What I wouldn't give for a Sparkton Pack right about now! But in its absence, we'll need to make do with a cruder method.
Each soul contains a shard of light that's infused with holy magic, even cursed ones. Go kill some of the ones up ahead and gather several of their shards. I need to study them immediately.

It's just as I thought. With only one sample I was able to figure out this dreadful phenomenon.
What? Why didn't I just ask for one sample to begin with? Because most of the specimen are bad, and I didn't want to waste loads of my time explaining the difference! Instead, we've let the law of probability work for us - typically, one out of every five is the right one.
Destroy 4 Skeletons and return to Blackhand the Unyielding.

Descendant of the Legendary Orc my ass! That ain't nothing but a shaman's fairytale! The only magic Orcs can use is holy magic. That and whatever other pagan rituals the shamans still practice. Death magic, elemental magic, mind magic - none of them are a weapon of my people. You should put these silly ideas out of your head and start accepting us for who we are. And that's it.
Hmm, I guess I've got a stubborn one here. Fine. Tell you what - do something for me and I'll throw some information your way.
The task is simple. Recently the undead have been pouring out from the lab in massive numbers, giving the Imperial soldiers trouble. You'll help them.
Kill four undead for me, and then we'll continue this conversation.
Is the job done? If the answer is no, then I've got nothing to say to you.

Is that so. Well, I always keep my word. Aye, an Orcish has been delivered to the lab recently. The operation was top secret, so no one knows any details, but I heard that the scientists had some pretty special experiments lined up for him.
Anyway, I'm sure the poor bastard is long dead by now. Just as all my boys that went in there are long dead! Argh! I never trusted those Arisen idiots and I never will. They really screwed things up.
Find someone that can reveal the identity of the cultist that infiltrated Lab Thirteen.

It's now official - the black stone suppresses holy magic, and when it does it summons Shadows. You remember that Tep had this sort of stone, right? He probably used it at the ZIT Headquarters to suppress the holy magic that was binding him and thus get an opportunity to transfer his soul into a new body. Ah, good ol' Tep. You never cease to amaze!
But let's return to our lab. This type of stone is the only thing that could cause the souls of the dead to be unable to resurrect. It must be blocking the holy energy that's involved in the process. Now we just need to learn how the stone got here...
There's only one option - we've got a traitor on our hands! The lab must have been infiltrated by a Tep cultist. Ooh, I'll be having a good chat with Mitrofan Semidolin about this! He swore to me that all the employees went through the most thorough background checks!
Listen, you need to make for the lab at once. The traitor may still be in there. Search every hole and every corner if you have to! Leave no vial unturned, you hear me? The truth is near and it's up to you to find it!
Meet Hammerblow the Fierce on the Old Square and request Gibberlings for the sake of art, presenting the instruction. The results must be informed to Uri Bondarin on the Dream Factory.

Here is one of the problems to be solved. According to the script one of the key scenes in our epic "Liberation" is Gibberlings' mental attack. Thousands of small fluffy creatures attacking the ship! Looks great. On paper!
But, tell me, please, where should I take a thousand of Gibberlings! Should I invade Frozen Frontier!?
Oh, this Bondarin! Blotter! I am speaking about the script writer! He denies to change Gibberlings to the undead! He says that Yasker has approved everything and not a single line is to be changed! How can I argue!
In short, now we try to find available Gibberlings all over the Empire. And you can help.
Grok the Bloodthirsty is known to you, isn't he? Standing on the Old Square, showing the Gibberlings for kicks of the people. Talk to him and take the Gibberlings for the sake of art. In case of his objection - show him the Order! He is an agent of the Council after all and has to fulfill his duty!
After that go to the script writer Bondarin. Supposedly a lot of troubles he has.

Gibberlings? What Gibberlings?
Ah, you speak about psionic attack, don't you! Oh, that's so unimportant compared to a new problem!
Go to the Factory of Dreams using ruins of June portal and talk to Ekaterina Feofanova.

You have several wonderful abilities, one of them is an ability to appear in time, in that exact moment, when I need you.
Yes, Motherland needs your heroic deed again! Don't worry nothing unusual about it. No world conspiracy, secret missions and other gray working days of Committee. We will talk about something Beautiful.
Brothers Sarbaz and Sarang Lumer, scientists of ZIT, made one discovery recently. A side one. When they were studying influence of mystical powers on the mind, they invented "Illusion". Using their new invention, one can recorder all occurring event on a magical strip and them relay them! Awesome! It opens great opportunities for the Committee! And not only for investigating materials.
We are talking about greatest weapon of propaganda! Finally, we can tell truth to our citizens, bring all latest Yasker's orders to everybody! Finally, we can record all our successes of our country to our progeny! And finally, we can demonstrate the League true situation.
We are working at it at the moment. "Factory of Dreams", as I call it, is situated to the west from Nezebgrad. This a place where "moving" history is created. Moving history is my term also. Ekaterina Feofanova is leading the process. She is experienced and respected Committee agent. I assume that she needs help.
If you use ancient June ruins, that are situated in the Nezebgrad's harbor, you can get there. Talk to Feofanova and help her as much as you can.

Oh, it's worst task in my life!
I need to deal with creative intelligence! They have no clues about working discipline! Everyone considers himself better, everyone has perfect ideas and each of them costs more than building of new XAES!
I have so much to do!
Obtain 2 League trinkets, a League weapon, and a League armor piece by fighting experienced troopers on the Lookout Isle, then bring them to Dina Ozerina at the Dream Factory.

Here is one of problems that we have to solve.
Dina Ozerina is her name. Firstly, she is director's wife. Secondly, she is main artist. Explosive mix! She orders to get original League armors and their house stuff! We tried our best, most well known masters of Nezebgrad were working on them. And she is not satisfied! Cloth is not the same, she says!
We have to obtain required items in battle.
Go to the Lookout Isle. League deserters landed there. They will help us, I'm sure.
Fight only experienced warriors, scouts and mages. The have new uniform and beautiful weapons, moreover they are rich and can have different small things that will be useful for us. When you obtain everything, bring it to Ozerina. I cannot talk to her anymore.

How one can work in such conditions? How?!
Pen-pusher from the Art! Parasites that are feed from creativity! Their only goal is economy!
And we are not playing cards here, we are creating everlasting things!

Oh! It's our survival!
Can you see? These things have the League smell from a mile! They are not fake, they are real!
Thank you! Now we have a hope that we can create something real! True!
Go to the bunker, with the help of roll urge the actress Gella Muhina and teach her elves-dancing. The results must be informed to the director Uri Ozerin on the Dreams Factory.

This is one of the key problems. According to the script the major enemy is the Elven mage playing dirty tricks on us. Initially this role was planned for a real elf, but... In one word, Gella Muhina was promoted to it finally.
What? Don't you know Gella Muhina? Hm... Lucky you are. Don't know how but this... smart lady managed to get this Elven role. No, it was not through the director's fault - he doesn't like it either. She has to dance Elven! But to put it mildly she does it not well... Xadaganian-like.
Ozerin, the director, is depressed. He is afraid for the major scene! He says that such dancing will result our epic into cheap amateur art!
We have to teach Muhina Elven dance. Have you ever been to bunker? Don't revert your eyes, everybody has been there!
Alright! If you don't want to confess... Let's pretend that you know nothing.
The entrance to Bunker is located in the Victory Park, in its south-eastern part. The guardian is standing by it. Say the password: "Procedure issue..." and enter.
In Bunker you will see the real Elves. They will be dancing.
Here is the roll of appeal. Muhina is ready. When you come to the Bunker appeal to her and help to warm into her role. She has to learn Elven dance!

Again wriggling to the art! By all means!
And the examples not far to seek! Muhina! She can not even imagine what is it like to be Elf!

What? Muhina can dance?
Don't believe before see it myself!
I am ready for the rehearsal!
Obtain 4 magic essences by fighting magic elementals and bring them to the scientist Sarbaz Anedjib.

This is one of the problems to be solved.
As far as you already know, the "moving" history was created by two scientists of ZIT, brothers Anedjibs. One of them is here at the moment. He is providing technical support for the whole process. I must say that this is very expensive. We are already overlimited! Almost all XAES works only for us!
During their research brothers Anedjibs used magic essence. So we need to get it. On an industrial scale!
Fight the Magic Elementals that roam along the shores, get the essence and bring it back to Sarbaz Anedjib.
If my construction project of a new XAES won't be accepted within three days, I waive the responsibility from myself!

What's that? Magic essence?
Furzina really thinks that we can work with it?!
What a blatant ignorance!
Hey, hold on! Give me the essence! One should value the energy of art!
Obtain 4 pieces of Boar Meat and bring it to the screenwriter Yuri Bondarin.

What do you think the work of a scriptwriter is? Hand write over heaps of paper? No way!
You won't believe it, but the scriptwriter is in charge of everything! How else could it be?
Take a look at the Gibberlings. At first I went hysterical to make Feofanova deliver them, and it helped, naturally! We've got the Gibberlings.
But has anyone given it a deeper thought? No! Now they're starving! Just fancy a mental attack of skinny, exhausted Gibberlings! Enough to make a cat laugh!
I literally have to bottle feed them. Their number is growing! There's a real mess!
Well, have I managed to deliver the importance of the issue to you? Then your help is welcome.
Kill the steppe boars and bring me their meat!

I wonder... When we eliminate the problem of feeding the crowd, what else is going to fall on my shoulders? Logically...
Hm... I wouldn't deal with these problems also!

Great!
Now when the Gibberlings hold the banzai attack they will look authentically!
Obtain 4 Growth Potions by fighting termites and use it to fertilize the saplings. Report back to Dina Ozerina.

How about doing something for the sake of art? Excellent!

We are trying to capture the scene of the military council of the League commanders. It took place in Kania, so we need to reconstruct the environment.

We planted a few birches here. They're pretty small and they don't really look like a birch grove.

There's one solution to this problem, and that is the growth potion. Once we feed the sprigs, we'll get our trees!

Termites that live near the Factory are the most suitable source of the potion.

Get four potions and feed the saplings. Then we'll work on the scene. Can you see those two Kanians? Don't touch them! Those are Xadaganians, it's just makeup. They are rehearsing...

Oh, so much trouble about this Kanian hut!
We took it longwise! By assault!

That's it! Now it is much more like a birch grove!
I wish the screenwriter made normal script! Just look at this heresy that these two Xadaganians and Kanians are talking!
Teach "Yasker" a battle craft, having outfight 15 "fierce Kanians" in the middle of the temple. The results must be informed to the director Uri Ozerin.

Besides Muhina I have one more. Yasker!
Don't be scared! It's not real. This is the leading actor. In make up. Resembles? Now you understand!
The problem is that he resembles only in outer appearance. And only when he does nothing. But according to the script he has to do what? To fight, yeah! He even took the staff the wrong way!
Listen, would you teach him a lesson? Now evil Kanians appear and attack the place of resurrection. And our Yasker will have to kick their asses. You'll manage, no doubt!
Are you going to help us?
Everything must be authentic! Especially what concerns the fight of our Great Sovereign with the enemy!
Great job! Hope it helps our Yasker to get into the role!
Get the fire essence fighting against fire elementals, and with the help of which set the Kanian ship model on fire. The results must be informed to the scientist Sarbaz Anedjib.

Ah! Everyone says about the great scale of our project! Tons of gold were spent! And what working conditions we have here? Wretched!
Have a look. We need to capture the Kanian ship on fire. And what I want to tell you. No money was given for ship construction and further destruction!
They say you are a wise man, so, please, find the way.
So I did. Let's set the model on fire and shot a close scene. Suppose we'll succeed.
Firstly we should check. Get some fire essence for me, I see you are good at such things and then set the model on fire. So we can check.
I wonder if we manage. Hope we do, otherwise... otherwise all is lost!

Look how it is burning! Wonderful!
Hm, may be the future is with it? I wish I have more of these essences and a model of a greater scale...
I have an idea! To capture the Great Cataclysm! That's nice... That will be impressive!
Go to the main pavilion of Factory of Dreams and talk to Ekaterina Feofanova.

Oh, I'm trying to find you everywhere!
We have an incident! Main actor, the one who players Yasker himself, is drunk! He is talking that he cannot realize such complicated character! A bastard!
And we are ready to capture all main scenes! Ship is repaired, Gibberlings are fed, extra players are gathered, actress is inspired!
Listen, you played him once! Please, help me!
Go to the main pavilion, its right behind the gates. I and all our team will be waiting for you there!
This "moving history" is the biggest headache, I've ever had! And I have seen lots of things in my life!

It's good that you are here.
We are beginning! Everyone take your places!

You are late!
Art is not a mess, you know!

Hi there, comrade!
What do you need?
There now, it's all ready. Equipment, and set design, and actors... What's taking so long? We haven't got all day! Go and ask Feofanova, what's wrong.
Right on time! The motherland requests your assistance again! I thought it’d turned out just fine, but it seems that I was wrong.
Defeat 4 angry Gibberlings and report to Ekaterina Feofanova.

First scene is that simple Gibberlings' mental attack. They are gathered, fed and ready to fight.
You are Yasker, capturing enemies' ship. You are alone, of course.
After my command you begin fighting Gibberlings and beautifully, nicely defeats them.
Is everything clear? We have no time for repetitions, we are beginning. I believe in your talent.

I hope that not only you will succeed, but all other services also.
We won't be able to see it once more.

Perfect!
I'm sure, Yasker will love this scene.
Go to ship's stern and read Yasker's speech in time. Report to Ekaterina Feofanova on finishing.

The next scene is a scene of seduction. Mean Elven mage tries to tempt Yasker.
Our leader demonstrates high more principles, that are part of character of each Imperial citizen. You will be demonstrating it.
Your partner is Gella Muhina. She is pro at tempting... Especially now, when she learned Elven dance.
Take it. These are texts of your phrases. You need to read them in time. An easy task - main thing is not to miss anything. When Mykhina, the Elf, says her words, you say yours after that. You voice should be strong, steel and courage. Is it clear?
Let's begin!

Maybe, it's the most important scene!
Everybody knows that Yasker can conquer the ship alone.
And that he also can pass through water fire and copper tubes... We should remind our people about this!

I'm excited!
Maybe even Yasker himself could not oppose enemy's charms so confidently!
Scene of final Elf re-education we will do later. There we will need other decorations.
Go to the reactor room and defeat June golem. Talk to Ekaterina Feofanova on finishing.

We are moving to a final stage.
When the Elf was reeducated, Yasker goes to the ship's lower deck to fight June golem than was used by enemy for reactor's defense. Yasker fought and was victorious!
I hope you know what to do. But... Zem engineers are not sure in golem's actions. He... In one word something can go wrong. So, the fight can a real one.
But I hope you won't retreat! Art requires sacrifice!
We can never be confident with those golems! June magic is so unpredictable!
We managed to capture this battle. I'm sure it will be a good decorations to our epic!
Meet Elizaveta Rysina and tell about success on Factory of Dreams.

Oh.
It's the end. We managed to capture most important moments. We still have much work to do, but only now I begin to feel confidence in out success.
Do you know what I want to say? I like it
Yes, it's very difficult. Yes, it's unorganized. Yes, it's foolish. But from this difficultness and foolishness a new branch of art is born. Flexible history!
Return to Rysina and tell her that everything is ok.
First performance is soon!

What are you saying? How interesting. Maybe I'll visit a Factory by myself one day. I want to look at it with my own eyes.
And maybe, a day when I will say: "From all arts the most important is... "Moving History" is not far. But it sounds bad, I should think about new word.
Wait until the experiment ends and destroy any threats that might appear.

I need to conduct a quick experiment. The gist of it is this - I put the black stone next to the shard of light. Simple. I expect for the shard of light to show a visible reaction to its proximity to the black stone. There's also a good possibility that a Shadow will appear.
Shadows are odd creatures. They can be summoned easily enough, but to this day no one's ever been able to retain control over them. With Tep being the sole exception, if that legend is even true.
But I am rambling. For this experiment we're not trying to control one. We're simply testing the powers of the black stone. Now are you ready to deal with whatever might happen?
Hold on, I'm studying the black stone and the shard. Hmm... Let's see here... Ah! A thousand bloody Teps! It all checks out!
Activate 4 Undead Destroyers and report back to Mitrofan Semidolin.

Here's the situation. Within the confines of Lab Thirteen there's been a series of experiments conducted, dedicated to establishing control over Astral demons. The brightest minds throughout the Imperial allods have been brought here for this very purpose.
All creatures with any form of mind control abilities have been studied by our scientists to no end. They hope to understand and amplify their abilities and then use them on the Astral demons. If we succeed, the possibilities are boundless!
But a few days ago, everything changed. No one knows exactly what happened, and none of the rescue parties have returned. Instead, the undead have been pouring out like roaches. We're practically in a state of siege at this point. But before you head down there, I need you to do one thing for me.
Near the entrance to the lab we've set up several mechanisms that we call "Undead Destroyers". They're a combination of holy magic and Arisen technology. Unfortunately, they're a bit unstable right now. They keep turning off for no apparent reason. Your task is to turn them on again. That should help clear the way so we can get inside.
Activating the things are pretty easy. Getting near them is the hard part.
The path is now clear. That means it's time for action!
Find 5 milestones of Gipat, touch them, and report to Lark the Ink Quill.

To learn more about Gipat, you need to find the milestones, mysteriously carved stones, that have been hidden in remote places.
Find such stones and touch them to feel its history.
Where are these milestones? Listen and remember for I will only say this once...
Misty Shore, Blighted Road, Wild Orcs' Camp, Windswept Foothills, and Cursed Path. You will find the carved stones there.
Milestones of Gipat Shard are waiting for you!

I wonder... Can you now claim that you are more familiar with Gipat and not from hearsay?
On one hand, you've seen all the nooks of this allod. On the other hand, if you just bounced between each stone without absorbing it's history then you will only cheat yourself in the end.
Get 7 Signs of Gipat fighting against dangerous creatures and bring them to Lark the Ink Quill.

Do not think you can compare yourself to the same level as Masters without at least defeating the most dangerous Gipat creatures?
Prove your might to me. Slay them all and bring me Signs of Gipat to show me you are the real deal.
The creatures that you must defeat to gain their Sign are: Viletongue, Misthoof, Takunda, Ethereal Cutthroat, Mogo, Goblin Barbarian, Guk the Primitive, Runeclaw, Redtooth the Unyielding. You can easily recognize these creatures by their names or by crown symbols above their heads.
Did you manage to get Signs of Gipat?
Excellent! The Signs that you brought proves you have defeated the deadliest foes on Gipat.
Kill 100 orcs on Gipat and report to Lark the Ink Quill.

Our world is not perfect... Ah! How truthful these words are! Well, I have lost my thought...
So, our world is not perfect. In every land you will cross paths with dangerous creatures that threaten natives. On Gipat such arch foes are... Surprise!... Wild orcs! These orcs do not revere law, they kill the Chosen ones, and they will prevent you from achieving Revelation!
Take this opportunity to show them who is the master of this land!
I hope word spreads throughout the enemy army of your determination to wipe them all from the face of this allod!
Those stupud orcs do not understand the the Revelation is much more important than their weird old traditions!
Find 10 Stones of the Past on Gipat and bring them to Lark the Ink Quill.

In all of Sarnaut there are lots of valuable resources that can be found in specific spots. Gipat is not an exception. I'm not speaking about herbs and minerals. The most valuable resource here is the past. That's right, the past. Now Gipat is only a reflection of the past. Nevertheless, there are pieces around us to help remember the past. There was a time when we would throw stones around for amusement. Now It's time to collect them. Bring me the stones of the past. Where you can find them? It is a mystery you must unravel. Hopefully you will be wise enough to find the answer.
Stones of the past can be found everywhere in Gipat... Hm, I nearly let out a secret!
Yeah, yes... Silent witnesses of the past tell all. Do you feel more connected to Gipat's history now?
Complete all quests from Anthropologist, Lanol, for a well-deserved reward.

If you successfully complete all my assignments, I will generously reward you. You will be able to choose the reward, which will help you fearlessly venture into the depths of Gipat Caves. Prove to me you are indeed the Chosen One!
Have you completed all of my tasks?

Few people could have accomplished what I set you out to do.
And even fewer of those who listened to me attentively. And I haven't yet met a person, Orc, Elf or other being who refused my trials after hinting at a wondrous. Those whose minds are only on materials tend to fail from not having the proper drive.
Although your intentions and motive is more than just seeking my reward, right?
Read the invitation to the show, take the Mysterious Stone attached to the letter, use it and meet with the Spirit of Peace on Gipat.

Hey! Some strange invitation to a "Show" has arrived for you. And there is a parcel with it, a stone. A black one. One item. Aha, sign here. Well, not with an X! No, what will you do.... Now you an take get your parcel. Our postal service is the most reliable in Sarnaut!
You are one of the few who to be fortunate enough to see the most unbelievable show that has ever been seen in this world! Put aside all enmity and prepare to enjoy an amazing spectacle!
Go to the Isle of Intrusion and kill 5 Astral Scouts, 3 Astral Punishers, and 1 Astral Destroyer. Report back to Spirit of Resolve in Gipat Settlement.

Glad you are here.
Overlord Zullo, who looked into your mind, told me that you might help me with a very important mission. We discovered a small astral island where the main body of demon army is located. They want to interrupt the Performance.
Your have to stop the intrusion. I can help you to get to the Isle of Intrusion. Demon Ancestors infest the island with the new sorts of beasts. Don't try to attack the Ancestors, this is useless. You should go for their offsprings. You may also have to fight against Astral Scouts, Punishers, Destroyers and Tainted Predators. Every new enemy will be stronger than the previous one. You must kill everyone to stop their advance, and be quick - you can only stay on the island while the Blessing of Overlord is active.
Can you handle it? Get ready then!
Have you cleared the Isle of Intrusion from demons?

Good.
If you want more experience, come back tomorrow. Demons will return and we will need your help again.
Place two Lantern Beams on the side of each shore and report back to Rodion Zotkin.

The League. Nothing but the League around! Look, there goes some more League citizens!
Not all Imperials have teleportation stones and the June portal here only works one way. Therefore, we need to establish convenient communication and transportation from Astral ships to attract more Imperial citizens.
Set the signal lanterns on the shore to light the way for our ships. Keep an eye out for debris on the shore - most suitable place for the lanterns. Remember, this is top priority. Your Chosen Path will not go anywhere.
The more Imperial citizens on Gipat, the greater chance that we'll get Revelation before the League!

So be it. Let this preacher waste his breath while the devout League crowd around like bunch of pricks. The Empire's members will make significant strides towards completing their Path.
I wish the boats would come sooner!

Thanks for your help!
Good luck on your Path and don't forget... For the Empire!
Show this mineral to Mohr in Gipat's Windswept Foothills.

You wipe off the dust from your finding. The ancient stone is glistening dully. It looks like a genuine June treasure. What is it meant for? You should ask the Wormfaces about that. Mohr is the keeper of this mystery. He knows what this is worth.

This mineral is quite old. Long, long ago they were considered valuable and rare, now they’re not good for a thing... However, memories of the old days are so dear to me. Bring me more of these, and I will reward you with another antique and curious thingie: an ancient costume or some headwear. These we don’t need any longer, see.
Place two Lantern Beams on the side of each shore and report back to Boris Kuznetsov.

I'm so happy to meet you. There seems be many Imperial citizens here.
At first I dove into the bushes at first site of Imperials, but later thought "What an idiot, we are at a Truce here. I have to admit I do feel safe among the Orcs' watch - very convenient to work in such conditions. The only thing bugging me is the scarcity of my League brothers and sisters! The League ships need to find the way to Gipat. Maybe you can help.
Set the signal lighthouses on the shore. Doing this will divert you from the your Chosen path temporarily, but will greatly benefit the League! There are petrified skeletons of sea monsters on the shore. That is the best place for the lighthouses.

Orcs started ghost-hunting competitions. I say let them have their fun while distracting citizens from their Chosen Path.
I sit here studying everyone's behavior. While the Empire inhabitants shoot boars all day, the League slowly progresses its faction's reputation.

Well done!
As soon as the League ships find their way to this allod, it'll feel more like home.
Bring 10 Ruby Minerals to Mohr in the June Catacombs.

During your journey in June Catacombs you can find ancient minerals. Some of them are valuable and others are not. As for me, I'm looking for Ruby Minerals. If you gather 10 Ruby Minerals, bring them to me. I can offer you a decent reward.
You can find ancient minerals in special boxes protected by dangerous enemies. There are also other types of minerals can be found in those boxes, such as Crimson Minerals. They are less valuable, but we need them too. I will exchange 20 Crimson Minerals for one Ruby Mineral. Keep it in mind, as you are hunting for treasures of the dead nation...

Fine. Now you can choose your reward.
Only a select few are privileged to wear this attire.
Bring 10 Sun Minerals to Mohr in the June Catacombs.

During your journeys in the June Catacombs you will find ancient minerals. Some of them are valuable and others are not. As for me, I'm interested in Sun Minerals. If you gather 10 of them, bring them to me, and I will offer you a decent reward.
You can find ancient minerals in special boxes protected by dangerous enemies. There is also Malachite and other types of minerals, less valuable but still useful for our people. I will exchange 20 Malachite Minerals for one Sun Mineral. Keep it in mind, as you are hunting for the treasures of the dead nation...

Fine. Now you can choose your reward.
Only a select few are privileged to wear this attire.

Hey, buddy! Listen, I've got something to say. Did you ever happen to visit June Catacombs? If the answer's yes, then I have a job for you! That terrestrial cuttlefish Mohr is looking for sun minerals and offers lots of interesting stuff in exchange for them. I got an idea... I know how we both can benefit from it.
In short, bring me twenty minerals of that sort, and I'll give you a pirate cloak in exchange! You won't find that cloak anywhere else, I swear!
Bring 20 sun minerals to Artem Shiryaev in the Gipat Ruins.
Well, how's it going? Found any minerals?
I'll be damned, you've made it! Well then, you take the suit, I take the minerals, as agreed. Now you look almost like a real astral pirate, haha!
Bring 20 Sun Minerals to Artem Shiryaev.

Yo, buddy! Listen up! You've ever been to the June catacombs? I've got work for you. This Mohr scumbag trades all kinds of curious stuff for ruby minerals.
So, I've got this idea how both of us can get profit... Bring me 20 Sun minerals, and I'll swap them for a pirate costume! A rare one!
Well, how's it going? Found any minerals?
I'll be damned, you've made it! Well then, you take the suit, I take the minerals, as agreed. Now you look almost like a real astral pirate, haha!
